title: Queen's Domain review
text: Where to start with Queen's Domain? It's tempting to begin with King's Field; after all, FromSoftware's seminal first-person action-RPG is an explicit inspiration for developer Freshly Baked Games. But 40 hours later, it feels like so much more. It's equally tempting to invoke another FromSoftware game: Dark Souls. Queen's Domain owes an obvious debt to that game's celebrated level design: the dazzling interconnectedness of its vertiginous world. But that's not quite right either. The deeper you delve, the more there's something of the spirit of The Legend of Zelda, a touch of Metroidvania too. Until finally you concede that Queen's Domain, with its remarkable world of densely packed secrets, is very much its own. Read more

title: WoW: Forever’s Best Buffs Now Work As Intended
text: World of Warcraft: Forever players will now be able to get even more benefit from the game's strongest buffs, as developer Blizzard's latest hotfix has made World Buffs persist across loading screens as intended. World Buffs are powerful stat-boosting effects granted to players in a particular area for certain events. The most common World Buff players see is Warchief's Blessing on the Horde and the new Might of Stormwind for the Alliance, which are granted to all players in Orgrimmar, Stormwind, and their surrounding low-level zones when players on their respective faction turn in a specific high-level quest. Now that players are reaching endgame and turning in the required quest, these buffs are popping off constantly. They grant a whopping 300 hit points, 15% melee haste, and 10 mana regen per five seconds for one hour. At lower levels, those are some serious stats, particularly the 300 HP. Unfortunately, players haven't been able to take full advantage of the buffs, as a bug was causing them to be lost when hitting a loading screen. That meant any time a group stepped into a dungeon or took a boat or zeppelin to a new location, their World Buffs would be removed. That has finally been fixed in the latest update, so players can now enter dungeons with World Buffs to help maximize their damage and health. This should be particularly useful for doing dungeons at a slightly lower level than is intended, as the extra HP and melee haste is definitely noticable. Blizzard clarified in the patch notes that World Buffs will still be removed when entering raids, so players won't be able to stack as many World Buffs as possible before raid night, as was the case in previous versions of classic WoW. Other changes found in the patch notes include a fix for an Uldaman boss that players were exploiting to make fast gold. Another is a fix for "a few spells and abilities" that were causing more weapon-proc effects than intended, likely nerfing the DPS of whatever classes were taking advantage of the bug. You can read the full patch notes below. Blizzard recently outlined in the latest episode of the WoW: Forever podcast how it wants to get rid of the idea of "best-in-slot gear," as well as how the game's has overhauled old-school WoW's player-vs.-player systems . In other Forever news, the game's launch has seen more than 15 million characters created so far, with the highest weekly player numbers for WoW in 15 years . CD Projekt spent a lot--more than 177 million PLN ($43.5 million) on development costs during the quarter--but the company's total cash reserves grew by 31 million PLN ($7.6 million USD). title: GTA 6 Is Giving Pornhub A Hard Time
text: Not even porn is immune to the GTA 6 effect, as it's just one of several forms of entertainment that has seen a decline in viewership since the massive open-world game launched. It's not surprising, given the game's record-breaking start, with 32.5 million sales from preorders alone. On PS5, GTA 6 is the "biggest launch" in PlayStation history, and players spent an average of 17.4 hours playing in its first few days--which probably didn't leave much time for a quick browse of after-hours material. According to Mashable , US traffic on Pornhub--which I've been told is one of the largest pornography websites, by traffic--dipped by as much as 15.5% an hour after GTA 6 launched. Paradoxically, Pornhub traffic had actually been up by 16.5% compared to average days, likely indicating that people were bored and randy. Pornhub traffic started to fluctuate after the GTA 6 launch and reached an average peak a few days later. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i7l7Lu69V_c Thanks to the game's massive success, we're also seeing the Rule 34 effect on GTA 6, as Mashable's research noted a 16,196% spike in GTA-related searches. Up to 15 million search queries were made on November 18 alone, with users searching for GTA 6, the GTA 6 strip club, and content depicting the co-protagonist Lucia specifically. The fan-favorite stalker--and possible serial killer--Mandy also appeared in search results, while Lucia's partner-in-crime Jason ranked low. Thursday Night Football also saw a big dip last week, with the lowest viewership of the season so far for a TNF game. While Rockstar's new open-world adventure can't be blamed entirely for that dip, it certainly must have had an impact, given that the football game was held on GTA 6's launch day. That effect didn't extend to the box office , as The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opened to a massive $120 million in the US, almost triple that of the last film in the series, The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes. title: Thursday Night Football Had Lowest Viewership All Season On GTA 6 Launch Day
text: The Thursday Night Football matchup on November 19, the day that GTA 6 came out, had the lowest viewership of the entire season so far for a TNF game, but the low ratings might not be due entirely to competition with GTA 6. The data shows that 12.23 million people, on average, watched the November 19 matchup between the Indianapolis Colts and Houston Texans on Prime Video. That was a 9% slide from the Week 11 Thursday Night Football matchup in 2025 featuring the New England Patriots and New York Jets. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dJDf76QVv70 Looking at week-over-week, the November 12 matchup this year between the Washington Commanders and New York Giants drew 16.27 million viewers , and was up 17% compared to the Week 10 matchup in 2025 featuring the Las Vegas Raiders and Denver Broncos. Due to the poor ratings of the November 19 TNF game, the full-season average now for TNF games this season sank to 16.62 million on per game. One expert told GameSpot that live sports like football probably won't be too heavily impacted by GTA 6 because people want to watch in real time. The low ratings for the November 19 matchup could be partially attributable to competition with GTA 6, but a likelier scenario is that people tuned out because it was a boring game in which the heavily favored Texans throttled the Colts by a score of 26-3. The Texans were up 17-3 at the half, and the game only had nine more points total scored in the second half--all by the Texans. Not exactly thrilling stuff that people would stay glued to. Ahead of GTA 6's launch, people also wondered how The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, which released on November 20, might be impacted. It may have been, but the film still put up massive numbers at the box office that exceeded expectations. GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies via pre-purchases alone and generated close to $4 billion on day one. The game will continue to sell, and it should get another jolt of sales when the PC edition arrives in 2027 , as rumored. title: GTA 6 Has A Secret Mission That Feels Like Hard Target Meets Saw
text: In the mood for a little bloodsport? In GTA 6 , you can teach one loud-mouthed hunter that Lucia (or Jason) is the deadliest game, as this secret mission will require cunning and sharp shooting to survive. It's Hard Target meets SAW, and the victor gets a pretty sizable stack of cash. Here's how you can be the most elusive of quarry. Go to Hyde Island Located north of Lummox County and the Moreau River, Hyde Island is where you can start this mission. All you have to do is land on the island, and after a few steps, a dart will hit you and knock you out. Listen to your captor's speech Now for the boring part. You'll wake up inside of a shipping container, with a fashionable explosive necklace locked in place. Once your captor finishes his rant, the game begins, and you'll want to move . Run to the tent directly in front of you You'll have 10 seconds to reach a tent in front of you, where you'll find a gun and a paltry two rounds for the sidearm. After the count is up, a hunter on a quad bike will show up, and he'll be gunning for you. To make things worse, he also has a dog with him that'll track you throughout the island. Don't engage him; he's heavily armored, and two bullets aren't nearly enough to stop him—besides, you'll need those rounds for his dog, Caesar. Sorry, animal lovers. Search for more outposts You can find more ammo, adrenaline, and a shotgun at nearby outposts. Each one is lit up, so be fast, be sneaky, and try not to get caught. The hunter is going to be tracking you constantly, even without his dog, and he has a sniper rifle that can take you out in just a few shots if he catches you. Prepare for a showdown Get as much ammo as you can, and choose your spot for the last stand. The hunter's dog will be a pest, so deal with it first. It's easy to spot, with a red light on its collar. Trees also make for good cover against the hunter, so once he's in range, start nailing him with shots to critical areas. Once he stumbles, unload a few shotgun rounds and finish him off. Collect your rewards Once the hunter is down, search his body for the Island-Poacher FF-50 sniper rifle and ammo for it. Head west to the boathouse to reclaim your personal items and $15,000 in cash. Not a bad haul for a deadly night's work. What happens if you fail? If the hunter does kill you, you'll lose a chunk of cash and wake up near one of your safehouses. title: How To Play GTA 6 On Your PC Or Phone Via Remote Play On Xbox
text: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 can be streamed via Xbox Cloud Gaming , and Microsoft has also now confirmed support for Remote Play on Xbox. This means you can play GTA 6 on your PC, smartphone, or a device like Xbox Rog Ally. Remote Play is an Xbox service that lets you stream games from your Xbox Series X|S to a device you might already have, and it's easy to get working. From your console, select Settings then Devices & connections then Remote features . From there, check the box for Enable remote features . Xbox Remote Play also has a "test" feature so you can preview the experience in your home environment before going further. From there, you can play GTA 6 from a mobile device by accessing the Xbox Remote Play website , selecting the console you want to connect to, and then the device. To play GTA 6 on your PC or Xbox Rog Ally, users can open the Xbox app for PC, click on their profile, then select Accessories & Remote Play and then select Remote Play to choose the device to play on. Additionally, people have spotted that GTA 6's store page on the PlayStation Store now mentions that Remote Play is supported and that PlayStation 5 and PlayStation Portal owners can use cloud streaming if they have a Premium membership. Right now, you need a PS5 or Xbox Series X|S to stream GTA 6, but some are dreaming of the day when you can simply stream the game to your PC or phone without any expensive hardware. That day may eventually come for GTA 6, as Take-Two's own CEO has said the rising cost of gaming hardware is not a good thing and that streaming games could be a big business very soon. “If you believe in streaming, and to be clear, we really do, and I’m happy to put a timeline on it. I think we’ll be in commercial streaming mode within three years, and by commercial, I mean low latency," Strauss Zelnick said. "That can 10x the effective installed base. Now, it doesn’t mean we’re going to 10x our revenue–and we wouldn’t project that we would–but because obviously your avid consumers already had access to video game machines. But I do think it creates great opportunity for titles that are broadly desirable, even outside of core markets.” GTA 6 is doing just fine without the potential expanded reach of streaming. After all, the game sold 32.5 million copies before launch and generated close to $4 billion in revenue by day one. Even if GTA 6 doesn't add support for full streaming without a console, the game is expected to expand its reach in a major way in 2027 with an expected PC release. Beyond that, GTA 6 is reportedly going to add an online mode in 2027 as well, and it could be bigger than Fortnite .

title: GTA 6: How To Go To Hell And Fight Satan
text: Grand Theft Auto 6 gets downright weird when you go off the beaten track, and one secret mission will see you travel to the bowels of hell to fight Beezleboss himself, Satan. This detour is worth it because you'll get cool cosmetics and a powerful shotgun, plus a nice little bump to your health. Here's how you can start this Doom-inspired mission in GTA 6. How to go to Hell in GTA 6 You can find this mission in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County , and it's generally recommended that you tackle it once you've gotten your bearings in Chapter 2 of GTA 6. You can access it with either Jason or Lucia, and you'll need to follow these steps to find it: Start the mission at night, preferably around midnight. Go to the northern section of Port Gellhorn (as indicated on the maps) and look for the Circles of Hell, a house with an open garage. Inside the garage, you'll find two NPCs rocking out. Press L2 to highlight them and start talking. Select the dialogue options " Having fun? " and " It's good " when prompted. Follow the NPCs into a van that appears shortly afterward, and get inside. After being transported to the camping grounds, press L2 to stare into the campfire. Once you've done all that, you'll be taken to Hell, and you'll have to face off against an army of demons. Don't worry! You'll be equipped with a powerful shotgun, so you can mow down the demons and fight your way to Satan. The Prince of Darkness will occasionally summon reinforcements to defend him, but the denizens of hell are no match for a few well-placed shotgun rounds. Finish off the devils, and you'll wake up at the campsite. For your efforts, you'll be rewarded with the following items and upgrades: Circles of Hell top New tattoo design Hellspawn Comshot 12 shotgun (collect it next to the throne) Permanent health boost For a closer look at GTA 6's supernatural side, check out how to encounter an unkillable NPC , solve the Bigfoot mystery , and help out some friendly aliens . title: Xbox Project Helix Was Reportedly Designed To Make Online Multiplayer Free
text: For years, most multiplayer games on Xbox consoles required a subscription to go online. From Xbox Live to Xbox Game Pass, Microsoft paywalled multiplayer on its platforms, but the company reportedly aimed to break down that barrier for its next-gen console, Project Helix. According to Windows Central , Project Helix was conceived under the previous Xbox leadership team as the device that would bridge the divide between PC and console gaming. Like the Asus Xbox ROG Ally PC handhelds, the console is said to have an Xbox-inspired interface and full PC game support through storefronts like Steam. Because of that design decision, it's claimed it didn't make sense to continue with paid multiplayer, since that service is free for games purchased on PC platforms like Steam and the Epic Games Store. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7H6YGeREMgY&t=159s As the Windows Central report noted, that was reportedly the plan before Xbox leadership was shaken up and gaming hardware prices rose during the AI boom. With Asha Sharma now in charge of Xbox, the gaming division is more focused on profitability, and Microsoft's gaming arm has seen sweeping changes. Mass layoffs and studio divestitures occurred throughout 2026, and Project Helix could be a very expensive family of devices. If Microsoft ditches paid multiplayer, it loses a revenue stream for its next-gen push at a time when component prices have risen steeply. As part of its 25th anniversary celebrations , Microsoft also teased a few more details about Project Helix, calling it specifically "a console" that plays games from your PC, not "a PC that can also play console games." "When we think about Project Helix, it’s really designed to be the ultimate gaming machine--one that removes all the barriers of play that have historically existed," VP of next-gen Jason Ronald said.

title: GTA 6 Hacker Releases Full Xbox Build, And PC Modders Are Already Trying To Get It Running
text: Infamous GTA 6 Leaker Cyberleek resurfaced last week , threatening to release a crucial file for the Xbox build of GTA 6 that could be used to create an unofficial PC port of the game. The hacker originally promised to publicly drop the .exe file for this version of the game depending on whether their memecoin hit a certain market cap, and has been taunting publisher Take-Two Interactive for failing to prevent the game files from leaking online. "Months of takedowns, subpoenas, and wallet-tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving," Cyberleek wrote in a now-removed post on Reddit, insisting they were "fighting anti-consumerism" in the video games industry with their actions and using crypto funds to work on a new project. "There is no other way to move funds without names," Cyberleek added. "And this work requires no names." https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i7l7Lu69V_c As pointed out online, Cyberleek has already cashed out on their memecoin in August and again in October, raking in hundreds of thousands of US dollars. So far, it looks like modders are already making modest headway with the full Xbox build of GTA 6, as the Project Leonida Discord server (via Eurogamer) has footage of the game booting up on PC. That's as far as it gets (for now), as that start-up process is met with a black screen shortly afterward. Modders and homebrew enthusiasts are reportedly using Claude AI to reverse-engineer the game on that platform, and the group is confident that a playable build will be ready within a week. title: This GTA 6 Glitch (Almost) Ruined The Game’s Most Iconic Scene
text: Note: This story will discuss a pivotal mission in Chapter 2 of Grand Theft Auto 6. A powerful sequence in Grand Theft Auto 6 is quickly becoming a favorite among the game's many players, but a technical mishap made my experience of this scene very different--hilariously different. Chapter 2 of GTA 6 begins with Jason and Lucia in a rough spot, with the former still recovering from major injuries sustained at the end of Chapter 1 , and the latter having to care for him. It isn't until the mission "Breakfast Run" that Jason is back on his feet, and the Bonnie-and-Clyde-like duo mark his recovery with a crime spree. Set to "Money or Nothing" by Dire Straits , Lucia and Jason rob a diner, not dissimilar to a scene from Pulp Fiction, and a playable montage shows the pair robbing convenience shops, a clothing store, and other establishments. The image of Jason and Lucia busting open double doors, guns in hand, is probably the most iconic image of GTA 6, a statement of intent that defines the game's story going forward. https://bsky.app/profile/compenderizer.bsky.social/post/3n2yzmpjn6c2j But somehow, I had gotten a slightly different version of this montage. When I returned to the motel as Lucia, I sprinted toward the door , only for the game to place me back outside the room. The game told me to "Go to Hank's Waffles" with no additional context, and I walked back into the motel to find Jason, not only up and about, but only sporting his underwear, bandages, and a buzz cut. I suspected that there was a cutscene that I missed showing Jason fully recovered, so I decided to carry out the mission. The problem was that Jason wouldn't put any clothes on. I drove to the diner as the game instructed me to, and the entire mission, Dire Straits and all, resumed with a mostly naked Jason. It was impossible not to cackle at the sheer absurdity of the situation, watching Jason terrorize locals and presumably solidifying a new legacy as the Leonida underwear robber. At one point, the camera cut to Jason's bare foot slamming a gas pedal, and I was left breathless from laughter. Eventually, the game decided to put clothes back on Jason, but I had to visit a salon to grow his hair back. Iconic. Though GTA 6 features nudity in various degrees, you cannot dress Jason and Lucia in their underwear outside of their home. That sprint through the motel room door must have bypassed some sort of clothing check and allowed Jason to freely show skin outside of the motel. I've seen players online talk about an "underwear glitch," and I found one Reddit comment saying that they also had a nearly naked Jason run about in "Breakfast Run," so I appear to be an edge case in experiencing this specific glitch. I can't say that this bug "ruined" one of GTA 6's best missions for me, as I still found myself thoroughly entertained--just not in the way Rockstar Games wanted. Having Jason in his undies while still concealing his identity with a hat and bandana felt like something out of a Saints Row game rather than the fairly serious story GTA 6 was building up to that point. Despite the intense work and detail put into GTA 6, it certainly isn't free of silly glitches and bugs such as this. Luckily, many of them are more amusing than hampering, and Rockstar Games is already putting out post-launch patches for the title. If anything, I'm just bummed that I can't spend the rest of the game as Underwear Jason.

title: Grand Theft Auto 6’s HDR Is Broken, But These Tweaks Can Fix It
text: Grand Theft Auto VI is a visual and audial treat, and is easily one of the most technically impressive games on the current generation of consoles. But it isn't without issues, especially if you're trying to experience the sights and sounds of Vice City with all the moody contrast and bright highlights that HDR offers. That's due to an HDR calibration tool that isn't exactly working in the way that you expect it. Like many other games, GTA VI doesn't use the system-level HDR settings on either the PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S. Instead it features its own calibration tool, which lets you adjust the maximum brightness, black levels, and paper white values that work best on your display. While the tool makes calibration seem straightforward, there's an issue with it that makes it very unreliable. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d3UaVoP6dPg Specifically, the maximum brightness and paper white point values seem to be linked in a way that is both unclear and incorrect. Normally you would set these values individually, with maximum brightness set according to the value your display supports and the paper white value that looks best to you. GTA VI instead changes the maximum peak brightness value it is storing as you change the paper white point. For example, if you set a maximum peak brightness at 1000 nits (a typical value) but then reduce the paper white point (given how how its default is), the peak brightness value reduces as well, with no indication to you that it's happening. HDR enthusiasts and handy calibration assistors HDTVTest and GamingTech have both confirmed the issue, and provided some rough workarounds until Rockstar (hopefully) releases a fix. The idea is setting the maximum brightness value higher than your display supports, but in line with what the game is expecting based on the paper white point value to choose. It's confusing, but GamingTech has drawn up a table that might help depending on your display's specifications. HDTVTest's approach is similar but with different recommended values for both the ideal paper white point and black level values, so you'll need to do some experimenting on your end to find what suits your setup best. Rockstar has released the first patch for GTA VI , but it mostly addresses some widespread bugs that players have been encountering since launch. HDR issues were also common at launch with Red Dead Redemption 2 but eventually were fixed sometime after, but if you're like 45 million other people and planning to explore Leonida today, then hopefully these tweaks let you get it looking its finest.

title: GTA 6: All The Secret Controls And Gameplay Features You Might Have Missed
text: On the surface, Grand Theft Auto 6 has a pretty standard control scheme for its protagonists. You've got everything you'd expect for exploring its open-world environment, from options to sprint to aiming your gun, but there's a whole lot more to the game when you start experimenting with the inputs. Whether you're driving or jogging, Jason and Lucia are capable of a whole lot more, and these hidden features aren't thrown at you when you start the game. Instead, you're left to discover them as you play, and each one adds another layer of immersion to the experience. If you don't want to accidentally stumble on them, here's a closer look at every hidden gameplay feature we've discovered so far. For more on GTA 6, from completing side missions to finding a tricky location on the sprawling map of Leonida, we’ve got you covered with our Grand Theft Auto 6 guides hub. Go into first-person mode Want to examine the world in more detail around you? Press L2 (LT on Xbox) to highlight something, then press R3 to go into first-person mode. Ordinarily, you can't move around in this mode, but there is a glitch to force the game to lock you into first-person. Change shoulder cameras Not too big a fan of the default over-the-shoulder aiming in GTA 6? You can switch which shoulder you aim from during combat by holding the left button on your D-pad while aiming with L2. Quick-swap between weapons At the same time, you can also quick-swap between weapons by tapping Triangle/Y while aiming, allowing you to keep blastin' like you're some sort of Frank Reynolds character. Do a combat roll! Need to close the gap quickly and avoid taking a few lead injections? Tap X/A while aiming, and you'll do a combat roll. Do a backflip! To show off some athleticism, run towards water, and as you get to the edge, hold X/A on the controller to do a backflip. Pistol-whip when you're out of bullets Got a gun in your hand, but you're out of bullets? It turns out that firearms are still good for inflicting blunt-force trauma, as you can use the melee attack (Square on PS5, X on Xbox) to knock enemies out. Choke enemies out For a stealthy beatdown, start a fight in GTA 6, grapple your opponent with R2, and then hold Square/X to set them up for a chokehold. Press the indicated D-pad button on your controller, and you'll trigger the chokehold. Chain-jump across gaps If you're running across an area that has multiple small gaps, you can tap X to jump across and tap it again to keep your momentum going. Your car door is also a weapon Instead of damaging the hood of your car in GTA 6, put a dent in your door by smashing it into a pedestrian. Like melee attacks, you can hit Square/X on your controller while driving to nail an unlucky person with the door. Your feet are technically free when you're on a bike And if you're not in a car? You can relive your Road Rash days by hitting the melee button to kick someone instead while you scoot around on a bike. Change how you wear your cap Whether you like to wear your cap in a traditional sun-blocking style or backwards, you can swap the position of your headwear easily. Just open the items and weapon wheel by holding L1, select items, and navigate to your cap. Press X/A and you can switch styles. Distract enemies with some whistling, which I can't do in real life GTA 6 makes for a surprisingly good stealth game, and for those scenarios where you need to draw enemy attention, you can whistle at them. Crouch, take cover, hold L2 to aim at a target, and press Triangle/Y to whistle. Loiter like a champ with leaning actions One of the cooler features in GTA 6 for photography fans is the option to lean against walls and railings. When you're near a wall, you can hold Circle/B to lean against it, and when next to a railing, press L3 to rest on that structure--pretty cool for when you want to take a photograph of Jason or Lucia while they chill out. If you're on solid ground, you can also hold down Circle/B to sit down. Choose your favorite hand If you want Jason or Lucia to emulate your dominant hand while they're holding something, press left or right on the D-pad. You can also make them hold two items at the same time, in case you want to show off that you're one of the lucky even-handed few. Auto-drive to destinations One of our favorite modes in the game--especially when we want to soak in the scenery of Vice City-- auto-drive is pretty easy to miss . While you're driving, hold the down button on the D-pad, press Start to enable Cinematic Mode, and then hold Circle/B to switch to auto-drive mode. You can also set the speed between slow/normal/fast for your commute. Quick-scan vehicles Instead of navigating to your WAiNK app, just hold Up on your D-Pad to bring it up instantly. Duck while driving so you can avoid being shot You're going to be in plenty of high-speed shootouts in GTA 6, and if you want to keep your head on your shoulders, hold the Circle/B button while driving to duck down. You have turn signals; use them Unless you're driving the equivalent of a BMW in GTA 6, you should use turn signals. While you're in your car, tap left or right on your D-pad to use these lights. They'll also cancel automatically after you've made a turn. Switch car headlights on and off Want to drive in stealth mode at night? Tap the circle button to turn off your headlights. Just don't be too surprised if other motorists flash you with their lights to remind you that you're driving dark. Leave the engine running Want to prepare your vehicle to be in getaway mode for a heist that you're about to pull off? You can leave the engine running by double-tapping Triangle/Y as you exit your car. Just be aware that this could invite car thieves to swipe your vehicle, since you're leaving it out there and purring. If you do this while piloting a boat, it'll also sail on while you explore the deck. Push vehicles In case you're stuck in a ditch or out of fuel, you can push your vehicle to safety. Position yourself behind, next to, or in front of your car (or boat), and keep pushing your character into it with the left stick until they switch to a pushing animation. Hold Square/X to move the vehicle, or flip it in case it has been overturned or beached. Leave your car door open You can also shave valuable seconds off your getaway by keeping your car door open. As you exit your car, press triangle once. Slide across your car hood For some Dukes of Hazzard action, sprint towards your car, aim for the hood, and tap X to slide across it. Yeehaw . Drop anchor If you don't want your boat to sail away without you while you search the ocean depths for treasure, make certain that you drop anchor. Press and hold left on the D-pad while piloting a boat, navigate to the vehicle menu with the right analog stick, and choose Anchor to lower it. Additional vehicle controls On that note, you can also find extra vehicle controls by bringing up the radio menu (press and hold left on the D-pad), and using the right analogue stick to navigate up. Turn radios on and off instantly If you're anything like me and your ears start to bleed when you boost a car that has the country music station turned on, double-tap left on the D-pad to instantly switch it off. You can smoke while driving Not that you should because it's bad for your health and both hands should be on the steering wheel, but you can hold L1 to bring up your items wheel, select cigarettes or a cigar, and then select R1 or R2 to start puffing away. Flick a cigarette You can also flick your cigarette when you're done smoking by holding the R2 button. Aim, and do that after you've poured out a trail of fuel on the ground, for extra cinema-style points. Flip the bird while driving The universal hand sign for telling someone that their driving is not up to par can easily be done by aiming at a motorist with L2 and then pressing R1 on your controller. Trash talk drivers Or if you need to give some verbal abuse, pull up next to another driver, press L2 to aim at them, and press R3 to give them some grief. Just don't be too surprised if they respond violently to your provocations.

title: GTA 6 Has A Super Mario Bros. Easter Egg, And It’s A Trip
text: Grand Theft Auto 6 has plenty of fun Easter eggs --many of which tie back to earlier games in the series--but you can also find a few nods to other megapopular game franchises hiding within the vast map of Leonida. If you take a detour along the north side of Lummox County, you'll come across an area in the woods that looks like it'd be right at home in a Super Mario Bros. game, and you can even collect two distinct caps for your troubles--which might suggest that the greater Mario multiverse theory is true after all. How to find the GTA 6 Super Mario Bros. Easter egg in GTA 6 You can mark this location on your map , as you can find the reference to the Nintendo mascot in Lummox County. It's up north from Mount Kalaga, at the end of a twisty road that seemingly goes nowhere: Hit the bong, dude Once you've arrived, scout the area for a purple tarp that has a bong sitting on it. Smoke it, get high, and climb the structure in front of you. You'll notice that there's a plume of smoke coming out of the one column, and if you stand in it, an invisible block will appear above your head. Smash the block Jump up, and you'll smash the block. You won't get any gold coins for your trouble, but you will get a nostalgic tune and two caps that reference Nintendo's favorite plumbers, Mario and Luigi. Collect the caps Each cap has an initial embroidered on it: "J" for Jason, "L" for Lucia. You can add them to your collection, or leave them to gather dust; it's up to you. As mentioned above, GTA 6 has references to a lot of pop culture. Someone at Rockstar Games is clearly a huge Dexter fan , Bigfoot is on the prowl , and I really wish I'd chosen the elevator without a killer clown inside it . For everything else on the biggest game of the year-- and maybe even the decade --check out GameSpot's GTA 6 guides hub .

title: This Terrifying GTA 6 Easter Egg Will Give You Nightmares
text: Rockstar's GTA 6 features a massive open world to explore, and people continue to make new discoveries, including a terrifying killer clown Easter egg. It's been discovered that the Haymarket building in Vice Beach County features an elevator filled with balloons. That's creepy, but not the worst. However, after entering the elevators, the doors close and the balloons fall to the ground. As this is happening, carnival music begins to play. The balloons then mysteriously float back up to the ceiling of the elevator, as the lights flicker and the music takes on an eerie tone. Then the lights go out and a killer clown with blood on his face and a knife in his hands charges at you as the lights go out. You don't die in this interaction, but maybe that's the point: to instill even more horror that makes you question if what you saw was even real. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ppnGzT4N4zA There are lots of Easter eggs in GTA 6, including an invincible NPC who teleports and a literal Easter egg . title: New Hunger Games Movie Blows Past Expectations After Some Feared GTA 6 Could Limit Its Reach
text: The newest Hunger Games movie, Sunrise on the Reaping, had a gigantic opening weekend that exceeded expectations. Some theorized it could struggle as people stayed home to play GTA 6 , which released one day prior, but that doesn't appear to have been the case. At the domestic box office, Sunrise on the Reaping earned $120 million for its opening weekend, with $105 million more from international markets for a total of $225 million over its first three days, according to Deadline . https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lYXtL5TreOE The franchise's second prequel, after 2023's The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes, Sunrise on the Reaping tells the story of the 50th Hunger Games, where Haymitch Abernathy emerged victorious. Joseph Zada plays him; Woody Harrelson played Haymitch in the original Hunger Games films. Sunrise on the Reaping also stars Ralph Fiennes as a younger President Snow, Jesse Plemons as a younger Plutarch, and Elle Fanning as a younger Effie. With $120 million for its domestic opening, Sunrise on the Reaping is now just the second prequel film ever to start with $100 million or more domestically. The current top prequel is 2016's Star Wars movie Rogue One, which made $155 million for its domestic opening. Some had theorized that Sunrise on the Reaping could suffer as people stayed home to play GTA 6 instead. Director Francis Lawrence said, "Hopefully, people find time for both." It sure seems like he was right about that. For comparison, The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes debuted to just $44.6 million for its opening weekend in North America, so Sunrise on the Reaping is doing much better. Sunrise on the Reaping is also Lionsgate's biggest post-COVID movie and its first film that opened to $100 million or more since 2015's The Hunger Games: Mockingjay: Part 2 ($102.6 million).

title: Somehow, Jensen Huang Returned
text: Nvidia has announced that Jensen Huang has been reinstated as president and CEO of Nvidia, while he'll also return to the Board of Directors. This is happening just hours after US President Donald Trump said Huang should come back . "The Board of Directors voted unanimously to reinstate Mr. Huang following a series of discussions and meetings with Mr. Huang, after which the Board was satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead Nvidia," the technology giant said. "In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang's reinstatement poses no national security risk." Nvidia chair of the Board Harvey C. Jones said the Board believes "Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners, and customers." "We have every confidence in Jensen and look forward to working with him as he resumes his leadership of the Company. We are grateful to Colette Kress for her outstanding service as interim CEO, in addition to her continuing responsibilities as Nvidia's Chief Financial Officer," he added. Trump said in a social media post that Nvidia's Board made "the correct and proper decision" to bring Huang back. Trump went on to say that the US government has no real to believe that Huang's return "poses any risk to national security." https://twitter.com/TheStalwart/status/2124868325524054057 For his part, Huang said he is honored to return to Nvidia to lead what he called "one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution." "I am also deeply thankful to our employees, shareholders, leaders across the industry and partners around the world for their extraordinary support. Above all, I am grateful for the love and support of my family. I can’t wait to get back to work.” Huang was ousted from Nvidia earlier this month after it came to light that he had a romantic relationship with a person that sources said was possibly a spy for China, though no hard evidence was ever provided to back this up. It was later reported that Huang had multiple other affairs with people he worked with. In response to the reports, Nvidia formed a committee made up of independent directors who had the job of investigating the "foreign intelligence" claims. Additionally, the committee hired an independent attorney to assist, and that investigation remains ongoing, with Huang's support. In addition to the internal investigation, there are multiple other open cases against Nvidia, including a probe by the SEC over financial accounting claims. In response to the entire situation, Nvidia has also created a new National Security and Export Control Committee to "oversee trade complicance and national security risks." Prior to today, Nvidia's board said it had no intention of bringing Huang back, but things can change fast. For his part, Huang said he would be "honored" to return as Nvidia's CEO. The Nvidia controversies led to turmoil in the stock market, in part because Nvidia is one of the “Mag 7” companies that are driving growth in the US. Some of the information coming to light suggests that Nvidia’s accounting and export control compliance are not buttoned up, and this has fueled further concerns about the growth potential and returns on investment for the AI trade. Numerous other technology and AI stocks have dropped in value significantly since the Nvidia news broke. Now that Huang is back as CEO, though, not only is Nvidia's stock price ripping, but the market overall--not just AI and tech stocks--is seeing positive upwards trends.

title: GTA 6 Is Approaching An Absurd New Sales Milestone, Report Says
text: Grand Theft Auto 6 's success continues to come into focus, as a new report from Alinea Analytics says the game sold 44.9 million copies through its first weekend. This would be up from the 32.5 million copies that Rockstar owner Take-Two announced last week, covering the game's pre-purchases alone. According to Rhys Elliott of Alinea Analytics , GTA 6 has reached 33.7 million copies sold on PS5 and 11.2 million on Xbox Series X|S, for a split of 75.1% to 24.9%. Take-Two announced $3.79 billion in sales for GTA 6 on day one , and Alinea estimated that the figure has grown to $4 billion through its first four days. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1YEHOKYVTho Sony and Microsoft keep 30% of the revenue for digital copies via platform fees, so those companies are winners here as well. Elliott went on to point out that GTA 6's $4 billion in revenue thus far is roughly equal to the combined box office results for this year's two biggest movies, Spider-Man: Brand New Day ($2.5 billion) and The Odyssey ($1.8 billion). Of course, GTA 6 is an $80-$100 game, while (hopefully) no one is spending that much to see a movie, at least not at one time. Elliott also shared data that shows around 40.8 million people logged in to play GTA 6 on Sunday, November 22, with PS5 making up 76% of those players. Additionally, Elliott said the data shows that about 20% of players--or about 9 million people--have spent more than 20 hours in the game already. GTA 6 is only going to get bigger when it comes to sales as more and more people buy the game. Additionally, GTA 6 is expected to come to PC in 2027 , which will be another selling cycle for the game. Beyond this, GTA 6 is expected to add an online mode in 2027 that will no doubt feature microtransactions and other ways for Rockstar to make money off the fanbase. For more, check out GameSpot’s GTA 6 review and our rundown of the five best things to do first. And if you’re eager for news on GTA 7 ? Get comfortable, because Rockstar is not going to announce it anytime soon .

title: GTA 6: Don’t Finish Chapter 2 Before Doing These Things
text: GTA 6 's first chapter is a lengthy prologue that gets you up to speed on the gameplay, the characters, and the storyline. But once you've cleared the final mission and you start Chapter 2, that's when the game really begins. This is where the protagonists Jason and Lucia cement their decision to go full Bonnie and Clyde, and since this chapter unfolds at a faster pace, you'll want to keep an eye out for a few missable items , people, and missions before you hit the point of no return that leads directly into Chapter 3. Which mission ends Chapter 2 in GTA 6? Appropriately, Chapter 2 in GTA 6 ends with the mission Checking Out after you reach the Move to Vice City point on your map, as Jason and Lucia will leave their current residence behind as they embark on a new journey to Vice City. To get there, you'll need to complete the following missions: What's in the Bag? Ambulance Chaser Just Moved In Girls' Trip Moses Daily Driver Slam Dunk Breakfast Run Coffee Break Afternoon Delight Checking Out Optional missions There's also a bunch of optional missions you can engage in, in case you want to score some more gear, unlockables, and cash before your Vice City trip: Check Out McKittrick Farm Collect Chemicals for Kyle Hit Avery Pawn Hit Kingpin Bowling Impounded Vehicle Pick Up a Gun Thrillbillies Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab Veteran Hunted (Jason only) Pay your room rent as quickly as possible One of your primary goals in Chapter 2 should be settling your debt with the motel manager Linda, as the more you delay paying her, the higher your checkout fee will be. If you purchased a necklace for Lucia in Chapter 1, Linda will hold it as collateral until the debt is settled, so reclaiming that sentimental piece of jewelry should be a priority. Talk to Wyman Chatting to Wyman and helping him out with his truck will also earn you an invite for a bit of off-roading fun with two of the missions: Thrillbillies and Twist, Wrist, Smash, and Grab. Find missing people While you don't have to tackle the Gellhorn’s Missing Tourist challenge as part of GTA 6's missing people questline during Chapter 2, it is recommended that you get this out of the way early. Starting this quest from Chapter 3 will be more challenging--for spoiler-specific reasons--and you can find those people of interest by checking nearby bulletin boards, posts, and notices. Play some pool Before you rob Frankie's Delights, go shoot a few rounds of pool to check off another task in your quest to be the biggest pool shark around. Grab some collectibles Several collectibles can be found in the Chapter 2 motel, so before you say goodbye to that location for good, grab 'em and sell 'em to help you reach a 100% completion rate in the game. Collectible cards Bryson Powers: On top of the washing machine in the motel laundry room Vicki: In the motel reception bathroom, on the floor underneath the toilet Victor Maravella: Check the fridge in the motel cafeteria Magazines Help Me Help You Help Me: On the motel reception desk Wizard Wang: In the motel cafeteria, next to the radio For more on GTA 6, from completing side missions to finding a tricky location on the sprawling map of Leonida, we’ve got you covered with our Grand Theft Auto 6 guides hub.

title: Cheeky Malware Linked To Popular Gacha Game Cracks City Security
text: East Asia--and particularly Japan--has been suffering a rash of cybersecurity incidents as of late, affecting everything from major banks and cellphone service providers to city governments and small businesses. Gaming has been one of many areas targeted: between arcade games on Sega's network going offline , 11 million Capcom IDs being compromised , and a high-schooler hacking Bandai-Namco , some major publishers have been suffering a string of embarrassments. One recent incident involved the PC launcher for the popular gacha action shooter NIKKE: Goddess of Victory , where malicious code would install a trojan called k2f that would compromise an individual's PC, taking screenshots, logging inputs, and installing/executing programs. Unfortunately for one Japanese municipality, someone's gacha habits may have lead to a much bigger incident. Iwamizawa is a city of about 75,000 located in Hokkaido, Japan's northernmost island. It's not a place that makes a lot of news, but it recently went viral on the Japanese-speaking side of social media. As reported by Automaton , the city issued a notice that an IT sub-sub-contractor handling the city's fixed asset records suffered a security breach--specifically, a k2f hijack. Observers soon surmised that the most likely source of k2f would be someone playing a certain sexy gacha game on a work PC. The subcontractor in question, IT services company GIS Hokkaido, would then confirm to Japanese tech news site ITMedia that, yes, NIKKE's compromised PC launcher was the source of the problem . When asked if an employee or subcontractor had launched the game on a work PC, GIS politely replied that "they would prefer not to comment." Moral of the story? While there's nothing wrong with playing a suggestive gacha game on your own time, you probably shouldn't do it on the clock, and definitely not on a company PC, lest you become internet meme fodder.
